title_en: Lu Shiwei v. Jingyuan County People's Government — dispute over administrative decision

full_text_en:
Lu Shiwei v. People's Government of Jingyuan County — Dispute over Administrative Decision

Plaintiff: Lu Shiwei, male, 48 years old, responsible person of Jingyuan Xinchao Garment Store, residing in Hejing Village, Wulan Township, Jingyuan County.
Agent ad litem: Zhang Yonghe and Wang Ping, lawyers of Gansu Dishan Law Firm.
Defendant: People's Government of Jingyuan County, Gansu Province.
Legal Representative: Dong Jiwu, County Magistrate.
Agent ad litem: Li Maorong, Director of the Legal Affairs Bureau of Jingyuan County, Gansu Province.
Agent ad litem: Chen Quansheng, lawyer of Baiyin Tongcheng Law Firm.

The plaintiff, Lu Shiwei, disagreeing with the administrative decision Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 made by the People's Government of Jingyuan County, Gansu Province (hereinafter referred to as the County Government) on September 6, 1999, instituted an administrative lawsuit before the Baiyin Intermediate People's Court of Gansu Province.

Plaintiff's Allegations: After the Jingyuan Garment Embroidery Factory (hereinafter referred to as the Embroidery Factory) went bankrupt, I purchased the property ownership and land use rights of the West Street Factory Area from the factory's liquidation group at a price of RMB 360,000. This matter was submitted by the liquidation group to the defendant for instructions, and the defendant previously approved it in its official reply Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134. I paid the full price, completed the property transfer procedures, obtained the state-owned land use certificate and an individual business license, and invested nearly RMB 100,000 to prepare for the establishment of the Jingyuan Xinchao Garment Store (hereinafter referred to as the Garment Store). However, just as I was about to commence business, the defendant demanded that I return the West Street Factory Area. After I refused, the defendant issued Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172, deciding to revoke Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134 and reclaim my state-owned land use rights. This administrative act of the defendant infringed upon my lawful rights and interests. I request a judgment to revoke Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172, to ensure that I can exercise property ownership, land use rights, and the right of operation over the West Street Factory Area, and to order the defendant to compensate me for economic losses of RMB 120,000 caused by its erroneous administrative act.

The defendant did not submit a defense.

The Baiyin Intermediate People's Court found the following facts through trial:

The Embroidery Factory was a collectively-owned enterprise. Due to continuous losses and inability to repay debts when due, it applied for bankruptcy. On September 28, 1996, the Jingyuan County People's Court ruled to declare the Embroidery Factory bankrupt for debt repayment and organized the Embroidery Factory Liquidation Group (hereinafter referred to as the Liquidation Group) to be responsible for the custody, appraisal, disposal, and distribution of the bankruptcy property. The Liquidation Group entrusted the Baiyin Asset Appraisal Office to appraise the fixed assets of the Embroidery Factory, and the appraisal result was RMB 444,366. On October 29, 1997, the Jingyuan County People's Court ruled to approve in principle the plan for handling and distributing the bankruptcy property proposed by the Liquidation Group, and decided to submit it to the audit department for audit of the bankruptcy property and then immediately execute it. On November 6, the Jingyuan County Asset Auction Committee decided after study to set the auction reserve price for the West Street Factory Area at RMB 400,000. On November 18, the Liquidation Group submitted a request to the defendant County Government, proposing to sell the West Street Factory Area (including land use rights) to the Garment Store by agreement at a price of RMB 360,000. Based on this, the County Government issued Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134, the "Official Reply on the Handling of Property after the Bankruptcy of the County Garment Embroidery Factory," approving the sale of the West Street Factory Area to the Garment Store at the auction price of RMB 360,000. On March 17, 1998, the plaintiff Lu Shiwei transferred RMB 360,000 to the Jingyuan County Enterprise Reform Office. On October 26, the Liquidation Group handed over all property of the West Street Factory Area to Lu Shiwei. On October 27, the County Government, by Jing Tu Jian Zi [1998] No. 112, granted the state-owned land use rights of the West Street Factory Area to the Garment Store for 50 years. Lu Shiwei, in the name of the Garment Store, signed the "State-owned Land Use Rights Grant Contract" with the Jingyuan County Land Administration Bureau, and on November 1 obtained the state-owned land use certificate.

When the plaintiff Lu Shiwei was preparing to commence business, the defendant County Government, on September 6, 1999, issued Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172, the "Decision on Revoking the Official Reply on the Handling of Property of the West Street Factory Area after the Bankruptcy of the County Garment Embroidery Factory," the main contents of which are: 1. Revoke the approval in Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134 for "selling the West Street Factory Area at the auction price of RMB 360,000 (including land use rights) to the Garment Store"; 2. Refund the RMB 360,000 paid by the Garment Store for the purchase of the West Street Factory Area, and compensate the Garment Store for the direct economic losses incurred in the purchase of the West Street Factory Area in accordance with relevant regulations; 3. After the West Street Factory Area is reclaimed, conduct an open competitive auction to the public in accordance with the Auction Law of the PRC, the Measures of Jingyuan County for Auction of State-owned (Collective) Assets, and other relevant regulations. On October 12, the County Government, in accordance with the spirit of Document No. 172, revoked Jing Tu Jian Zi [1998] No. 112, and at the same time revoked the "State-owned Land Use Rights Grant Contract" signed between the Jingyuan County Land Administration Bureau and the Garment Store, issuing a document to reclaim the Garment Store's state-owned land use rights.

The above facts are confirmed by evidence including the statements of both parties, the meeting minutes of the Jingyuan County Asset Auction Committee, and the County Government documents.

The Baiyin Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant County Government, by issuing Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172, decided to revoke the official reply on the handling of property of the West Street Factory Area. The factual findings are clear, the applicable law is correct, and the legal procedures are lawful, and it should be upheld. The plaintiff Lu Shiwei's request to revoke Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 and to ensure his exercise of property ownership, land use rights, and the right of operation over the West Street Factory Area is without legal basis and is not supported. Regarding Lu Shiwei's claim for direct economic losses to be compensated by the County Government, the County Government has already decided to provide compensation in accordance with relevant regulations, and this case will not address it further. The claim for indirect economic losses to be compensated by the County Government is not supported because there is no causal relationship with this case. Accordingly, the Baiyin Intermediate People's Court, pursuant to Article 54, Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC, entered the following judgment:

Uphold the Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 "Decision on Revoking the Official Reply on the Handling of Property of the West Street Factory Area after the Bankruptcy of the County Garment Embroidery Factory" made by the defendant County Government.

Court acceptance fee of RMB 4,010 shall be borne by the plaintiff Lu Shiwei.

After the judgment of first instance was pronounced, Lu Shiwei, disagreeing, appealed to the Gansu High People's Court. The reasons for appeal were: The Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 decision made by the appellee has neither factual basis nor legal basis and should be revoked. The first instance judgment upholding it was an error in the application of law. The request was to revoke the original judgment and revoke Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172. The appellee County Government argued in its defense: Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134 approved the sale of the West Street Factory Area to the Garment Store, but when the document was issued, the Garment Store referred to therein had not yet been registered according to law and did not actually exist; that official reply approved the sale of the West Street Factory Area at the auction price, but the West Street Factory Area was in fact not publicly auctioned; due to the carelessness of the work of the Liquidation Group, Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134 was erroneous and should be revoked. The appellee's decision to revoke Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134 by issuing Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 was correct. The first instance judgment had clear factual findings, conclusive evidence, correct application of law, and lawful legal procedures, and should be upheld.

The Gansu High People's Court, through trial, in addition to confirming the facts found at first instance, also found that: On November 18, 1997, the Liquidation Group submitted a request to the appellee County Government stating: Through liquidation by the Liquidation Group and appraisal by the Asset Appraisal Office, the total assets of the Embroidery Factory were RMB 748,500 (excluding land). Upon coordination by the County Deepening Enterprise Reform Leading Group, the County Auction Committee at its meeting on November 6, 1997, studied and agreed to adopt the method of negotiated sale, with a sale price of RMB 1,160,000 (including land). Among them, the South Street Market was sold to the Jingyuan County State Taxation Bureau at a price of RMB 800,000 (including land); the West Street Factory Area was sold to the Garment Store at a price of RMB 360,000 (including land). The proceeds from the sale and transfer were to be used to pay bankruptcy expenses and employee placement costs. On March 1, 1999, the Jingyuan County Administration for Industry and Commerce registered the Garment Store and issued business license Jing Gong Shang Zi No. 5295.

The Gansu High People's Court held:

All state administrative organs must administer according to law. Administering according to law requires not only that the content of specific administrative acts be lawful, but also that the procedures of specific administrative acts be lawful. If specific administrative acts of an administrative organ have illegal phenomena such as exceeding authority or abusing power, the law will surely not uphold them.

Article 74 of the Supreme People's Court's "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the PRC (for Trial Implementation)" provides: "The bankruptcy and debt repayment procedures of legal persons of non-wholly state-owned enterprises shall be governed by the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law." Article 201, Paragraph 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC provides: "The people's court may organize relevant organs and relevant persons to form a liquidation organization. The liquidation organization shall be responsible for the custody, appraisal, disposal, and distribution of the bankruptcy property. The liquidation organization may carry out necessary civil activities according to law." Paragraph 2 provides: "The liquidation organization shall be responsible to the people's court and report its work." Article 240 of the Supreme People's Court's "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC" provides: "Collectively-owned enterprises with legal person status, joint venture enterprises, private enterprises, and Sino-foreign equity joint ventures, Sino-foreign cooperative joint ventures, and wholly foreign-owned enterprises established within the territory of China shall apply the bankruptcy and debt repayment procedures for enterprise legal persons." Article 246 provides: "In accordance with Article 201 of the Civil Procedure Law, where the people's court organizes the establishment of a bankruptcy liquidation organization, the plan for the handling and distribution of bankruptcy property shall be proposed by the bankruptcy liquidation organization, discussed and approved by the creditors' meeting, and submitted to the people's court for ruling before execution."

According to the above provisions, the entity authorized to be responsible for the custody, appraisal, disposal, and distribution of the bankruptcy property of a collectively-owned enterprise is the liquidation organization organized by the people's court pursuant to its powers. In this case, after the Embroidery Factory, a collectively-owned enterprise, was declared bankrupt, the Jingyuan County People's Court had already formed a Liquidation Group for the bankrupt enterprise. This Liquidation Group had the authority to propose a plan on at what price, by what method, and to whom to sell the bankruptcy property, which could be executed after being discussed and approved by the creditors' meeting and submitted to the people's court for ruling. In addition, the Liquidation Group, as a civil subject, could carry out necessary and equal civil activities with other civil subjects. The liquidation organization is only responsible to the people's court and reports its work according to law. No other organization has the authority to handle the bankruptcy property or to require the liquidation organization to be responsible to it or report its work to it. After the bankruptcy property disposal plan was confirmed by the ruling of the Jingyuan County People's Court, the Liquidation Group's decision to sell the West Street Factory Area to the appellant Lu Shiwei at a negotiated price of RMB 360,000 was a necessary civil activity carried out by the Liquidation Group in exercising its own functions and powers. In the process of selling the West Street Factory Area, the Liquidation Group and Lu Shiwei formed a civil legal relationship of sale between equal subjects. The transaction they reached for the sale of the West Street Factory Area was lawful and valid.

After the bankruptcy property disposal plan in this case was confirmed by the ruling of the Jingyuan County People's Court, instead of immediately executing it, the Liquidation Group further submitted a request to the appellee County Government, which was not responsible for this work. This did not conform to legal procedures. After receiving the illegal request from the Liquidation Group, the County Government, instead of refusing to accept it on the grounds that it was not within its scope of authority, approved it by issuing Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134, thereby exceeding its authority. The County Government, by Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172, decided to revoke its own Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134 official reply, but the reason for the revocation was not that the official reply exceeded its authority, but rather that the official reply approved the sale of the West Street Factory Area to the Garment Store, which had not yet been registered at the time; and also that the Liquidation Group, when selling the West Street Factory Area, did not conduct a public auction at the "auction price" as mentioned in the official reply. This constitutes an unclear determination of the illegal facts of Jing Zheng Fa [1997] No. 134 by the County Government.

Based on these two erroneous understandings, the appellee County Government, in Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172, further decided: to refund the RMB 360,000 used by the Garment Store to purchase the West Street Factory Area, to reclaim the already sold West Street Factory Area, and at the same time to reclaim the Garment Store's state-owned land use rights. The West Street Factory Area was purchased by the appellant Lu Shiwei's Garment Store from the Liquidation Group, which had the authority to conduct such a transaction, through an equal transaction. This transaction was not only complete with payment and delivery, but also went through the procedures for the grant of state-owned land use rights. Lu Shiwei, in order to open the Garment Store he intended to establish in the West Street Factory Area, had already obtained a business license. These facts all prove that the property ownership and land use rights of the West Street Factory Area had already been lawfully transferred, and were no longer bankruptcy property under the custody of the Liquidation Group. These decisions in Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 would inevitably disrupt the already successful equal transaction and hinder Lu Shiwei from realizing his lawful rights and interests.

Even if the Liquidation Group dared not exercise its authority, or believed that there were various objective circumstances making it difficult to exercise its authority independently, and insisted on submitting its own work to the appellee County Government for instructions, and the County Government was willing to manage matters not within its jurisdiction, that could only form a unique relationship between the Liquidation Group and the County Government. The County Government has no right to use such a legally baseless unique relationship to influence others, to create new rights and obligations for others, or to hinder others' lawful rights and interests. The specific administrative acts implemented by the County Government in Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 not only exceeded its authority but also constituted an abuse of power.

Furthermore, any specific administrative act of an administrative organ must be based on clear legal provisions. The appellee County Government's Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 did not specify the legal basis for making the specific administrative act, which constitutes an improper application of law.

In summary, the Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 issued by the appellee County Government has errors such as unclear factual findings, insufficient evidence, exceeding authority, and improper application of law, and should be revoked. The first instance judgment upholding this specific administrative act was clearly improper and should be reversed. The appellant Lu Shiwei's request that the appellee County Government compensate for economic losses caused by the erroneous administrative act, having failed to provide effective evidence at first instance, constitutes insufficient evidence and is not supported. Accordingly, the Gansu High People's Court, pursuant to Article 61(2) and Article 54(2) of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC, entered the following judgment:

1. Revoke the administrative judgment of first instance;
2. Revoke the Jing Zheng Fa [1999] No. 172 "Decision on Revoking the Official Reply on the Handling of Property of the West Street Factory Area after the Bankruptcy of the County Garment Embroidery Factory" made by the appellee County Government.

Court acceptance fees of the first instance and the second instance totaling RMB 8,020 shall be borne by the appellee County Government.
